# Single_Goal_Holding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The neural mechanism by which an organism maintains a persistent, singular behavioral objective despite conflicting sensory or internal cues. Understanding this enables the design of compact, low-power neural circuits for sustained task focus in edge or in-network neuromorphic systems.
